019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;

021import java.lang.reflect.*;

028/**
029 * JUnit 5 extension that discovers {@link TestBean @TestBean}-annotated members on a test class and exposes them as
030 * a {@link TestBeanStore} overlay.
031 *
032 * <a id="ModeInject"></a>
033 * <h2 class='section'>Mode INJECT &mdash; fresh-instance with overrides (default):</h2>
034 * <p>
035 * The extension supports two wiring patterns.  <b>Mode INJECT</b> is the default and what every
036 * {@code @TestBean}-based test ships with out of the box.  The contract:
037 * <ul>
038 *    <li>The SUT (a {@code RestContext} via {@code MockRestClient}, a {@code Microservice}, a {@code SerializerSet},
039 *       etc.) is constructed <i>after</i> the overlay is built.  The overlay is threaded into the builder via
040 *       {@code overridingBeanStore(...)} (see {@link BeanStoreOverridable}), which
041 *       installs it in the {@code overridingParent} slot of the SUT's bean store at construction time.
042 *    <li>Because the overlay sits at tier&nbsp;1 of the resolution chain, every framework-managed bean lookup
043 *       consults it <i>before</i> any local {@code @Bean} factory or memoizer-backed default.  Mode INJECT is
044 *       therefore <i>universal</i>: all bean types are eligible for replacement, including those that subsequently
045 *       get pinned into a per-op memoizer.
046 *    <li>The overlay's lifetime is bounded by the SUT's lifetime.  For a per-test fresh SUT (the most common
047 *       shape), the overlay is discarded when the SUT goes out of scope at {@code @AfterEach}.  For a per-class
048 *       shared SUT (built once in {@code @BeforeAll}), the overlay survives until the SUT is torn down at
049 *       {@code @AfterAll}.  No explicit push/pop is required.
050 * </ul>
051 *
052 * <p>
053 * {@link TestBean @TestBean}, {@link TestBeanStore},
054 * {@link BeanStoreOverridable BeanStoreOverridable}, and the {@code overridingBeanStore(...)}
055 * setters on {@code MockRestClient.Builder}, {@code Microservice.Builder}, {@code SerializerSet.Builder},
056 * {@code ParserSet.Builder}, and {@code EncoderSet.Builder} all implement this Mode INJECT contract.
057 *
058 * <a id="ModeOverlay"></a>
059 * <h2 class='section'>Mode OVERLAY &mdash; existing-instance with push/pop:</h2>
060 * <p>
061 * <b>Mode OVERLAY</b> is the opt-in pattern for tests that hold a <i>long-lived</i> SUT (typically a
062 * {@code Microservice} booted in {@code @BeforeAll}) and want to apply per-test overlays without rebuilding it.
063 * The test calls {@link #attach(WritableBeanStore)} to point the extension at the
064 * SUT's bean store; the extension then uses
065 * {@link WritableBeanStore#pushOverlay(BeanStore)}
066 * at {@code beforeEach} / {@code beforeAll} and
067 * {@link WritableBeanStore#popOverlay(Snapshot)}
068 * at {@code afterEach} / {@code afterAll} so the SUT's bean store is restored between tests.
069 *
070 * <p>
071 * Mode OVERLAY requires {@code @TestBean(mode = Mode.OVERLAY)} on the participating annotations.  Mixing
072 * {@code Mode.INJECT} and {@code Mode.OVERLAY} on the same scope is rejected with a clear
073 * {@link IllegalStateException}.
074 *
075 * <h2 class='section'>Overlay storage:</h2>
076 * <p>
077 * The extension owns one or two {@link TestBeanStore} overlays per test execution:
078 * <ul>
079 *    <li>A <b>class-scope</b> overlay built at {@code beforeAll}, containing every {@code @TestBean(scope = CLASS)}
080 *       declared on {@code static} fields/methods of the test class hierarchy.  Lives until {@code afterAll}.
081 *    <li>A <b>method-scope</b> overlay built at {@code beforeEach}, containing every {@code @TestBean(scope = METHOD)}
082 *       declared on instance (or static, for convenience) fields/methods.  The method-scope overlay's parent is set
083 *       to the class-scope overlay (if any), so a method-scope override of {@code (Type, name)} shadows a
084 *       class-scope override of the same pair while still letting the class-scope's other entries fall through.
085 *       Lives until {@code afterEach}.
086 * </ul>
087 *
088 * <p>
089 * Wiring into the system under test is <i>explicit</i> &mdash; the extension never reflects on the test class to
090 * find a {@code RestContext} / {@code Microservice} field and never mutates the SUT after construction.  Test
091 * authors retrieve the current overlay via {@link #getStore()} and plug it into the SUT's builder hook:
092 *
093 * <p class='bjava'>
094 *    <ja>@ExtendWith</ja>(JuneauBeanStoreExtension.<jk>class</jk>)
095 *    <jk>class</jk> MyResourceTest {
096 *       <ja>@TestBean</ja> MyService <jv>mockSvc</jv> = Mockito.<jsm>mock</jsm>(MyService.<jk>class</jk>);
097 *
098 *       <ja>@Test</ja>
099 *       <jk>void</jk> aTest(TestBeanStore <jv>store</jv>) {
100 *          <jk>var</jk> <jv>client</jv> = MockRestClient.<jsm>create</jsm>(MyResource.<jk>class</jk>)
101 *             .overridingBeanStore(<jv>store</jv>)
102 *             .build();
103 *          <jv>client</jv>.get(<js>"/svc"</js>).run().assertStatus().is(200);
104 *       }
105 *    }
106 * </p>
107 *
108 * <p>
109 * Two registration styles are supported:
110 * <ul>
111 *    <li><b>Declarative:</b> {@code @ExtendWith(JuneauBeanStoreExtension.class)} on the test class.
112 *    <li><b>Programmatic:</b> a {@code @RegisterExtension} field initialized with {@link #create()}, so the test can
113 *       invoke {@link #getStore()} from within {@code @BeforeAll} / {@code @BeforeEach} bodies as well as from test
114 *       methods.
115 * </ul>
116 *
117 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
118 *    <li class='ja'>{@link TestBean} - The annotation discovered by this extension.
119 *    <li class='jc'>{@link TestBeanStore} - The overlay type the extension produces.
120 *    <li class='je'>{@link Scope} - Per-method vs per-class lifecycle selector.
121 *    <li class='je'>{@link Mode} - Mode INJECT (fresh instance) vs Mode OVERLAY (existing instance push/pop) selector.
122 * </ul>
123 *
124 * @since 10.0.0
125 */
126@SuppressWarnings({
127   "java:S3011", // setAccessible(true) is required to read package-private/private @TestBean members on user test classes
128   "java:S3776", // populateStaticOverrides() and populateInstanceOverrides() scan annotated fields/methods and modes in one pass; splitting them would obscure the override rules
129   "resource" // BeanStore lookups return Closeables owned by the JUnit lifecycle; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
130})
131public class JuneauBeanStoreExtension implements BeforeAllCallback, AfterAllCallback, BeforeEachCallback,
132      AfterEachCallback, ParameterResolver {
133
134   private static final ExtensionContext.Namespace NAMESPACE = ExtensionContext.Namespace.create(JuneauBeanStoreExtension.class);
135   private static final String KEY_CLASS_STORE = "class-store";
136   private static final String KEY_METHOD_STORE = "method-store";
137   private static final String KEY_CLASS_SNAPSHOT = "class-snapshot";
138   private static final String KEY_METHOD_SNAPSHOT = "method-snapshot";
139
140   /**
141    * Creates a new, unconfigured extension instance for programmatic registration via {@code @RegisterExtension}.
142    *
143    * <p>
144    * Equivalent to {@code new JuneauBeanStoreExtension()} but reads more naturally at the registration site:
145    *
146    * <p class='bjava'>
147    *    <ja>@RegisterExtension</ja>
148    *    JuneauBeanStoreExtension <jv>ext</jv> = JuneauBeanStoreExtension.<jsm>create</jsm>();
149    * </p>
150    *
151    * @return A new extension instance.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
152    * @since 10.0.0
153    */
154   public static JuneauBeanStoreExtension create() {
155      return new JuneauBeanStoreExtension();
156   }
157
158   private ExtensionContext currentClassContext;
159   private ExtensionContext currentMethodContext;
160   private final AtomicReference<WritableBeanStore> attached = new AtomicReference<>();
161
162   /**
163    * Constructor.
164    */
165   public JuneauBeanStoreExtension() { /* no-op */ }
166
167   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
168   // Mode OVERLAY attach / detach
169   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
170
171   /**
172    * Points this extension at a long-lived SUT's {@link WritableBeanStore} for Mode OVERLAY push/pop wiring.
173    *
174    * <p>
175    * Call from a {@code @BeforeAll} or {@code @BeforeEach} body when the participating {@code @TestBean} declarations
176    * use {@link Mode#OVERLAY}.  Once attached, the extension will:
177    * <ul>
178    *    <li>{@link WritableBeanStore#pushOverlay(BeanStore) push} the class-scope overlay onto the attached store at
179    *       {@code beforeAll} (if a non-empty class-scope overlay exists), and
180    *       {@link WritableBeanStore#popOverlay(Snapshot) pop} it at {@code afterAll}.
181    *    <li>Push the method-scope overlay at {@code beforeEach} and pop it at {@code afterEach}.
182    * </ul>
183    *
184    * <p>
185    * Calling {@code attach(...)} a second time before {@link #detach()} is permitted &mdash; the most recent
186    * attachment wins.  If never called, the extension stays in Mode INJECT.
187    *
188    * @param store The bean store to push/pop overlays against.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
189    * @return This extension, for fluent chaining.
190    * @throws NullPointerException If {@code store} is <jk>null</jk>.
191    * @since 10.0.0
192    */
193   public JuneauBeanStoreExtension attach(WritableBeanStore store) {
194      Objects.requireNonNull(store, "store must not be null");
195      attached.set(store);
196      return this;
197   }
198
199   /**
200    * Clears the {@link #attach(WritableBeanStore) attached} bean store reference.
201    *
202    * <p>
203    * Called automatically at {@code afterAll}; tests may also call it explicitly between scenarios.  Has no effect
204    * if the extension is not currently attached.
205    *
206    * @return This extension, for fluent chaining.
207    * @since 10.0.0
208    */
209   public JuneauBeanStoreExtension detach() {
210      attached.set(null);
211      return this;
212   }
213
214   /**
215    * Returns the {@link #attach(WritableBeanStore) attached} bean store, or empty if none.
216    *
217    * <p>
218    * Surface for diagnostic / testability purposes &mdash; the push/pop lifecycle uses the field directly.
219    *
220    * @return The attached store, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not currently attached.
221    * @since 10.0.0
222    */
223   public Optional<WritableBeanStore> getAttachedStore() {
224      return o(attached.get());
225   }
226
227   /**
228    * Returns the current effective overlay &mdash; method-scope if a test method is executing, otherwise the
229    * class-scope overlay.
230    *
231    * <p>
232    * This is the accessor most tests plug into builder hooks such as
233    * {@code MockRestClient.Builder.overridingBeanStore(...)}.
234    *
235    * @return The current overlay.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
236    * @throws IllegalStateException If no class-scope or method-scope overlay is currently active (e.g. the accessor
237    *    is called from a {@code @BeforeAll} body and the extension is not yet bound to a test class).
238    * @since 10.0.0
239    */
240   public TestBeanStore getStore() {
241      var s = currentMethodStore();
242      if (s != null)
243         return s;
244      s = currentClassStore();
245      if (s != null)
246         return s;
247      throw new IllegalStateException("JuneauBeanStoreExtension is not currently bound to a test class or test method.");
248   }
249
250   /**
251    * Returns the overlay for the specified scope, if one is currently active.
252    *
253    * <p>
254    * Allows a test to reach past the current effective overlay and inspect a specific lifecycle layer.  For
255    * example, a test running under both a class-scope and a method-scope overlay can use
256    * {@code getStore(Scope.CLASS)} to retrieve the shared per-class layer directly.
257    *
258    * @param scope The lifecycle scope to query.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
259    * @return The overlay for that scope, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no such overlay is active.
260    * @since 10.0.0
261    */
262   public Optional<TestBeanStore> getStore(Scope scope) {
263      Objects.requireNonNull(scope, "scope must not be null");
264      return o(scope == Scope.METHOD ? currentMethodStore() : currentClassStore());
265   }
266
267   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
268   // Lifecycle callbacks
269   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
270
271   @Override /* BeforeAllCallback */
272   public void beforeAll(ExtensionContext context) {
273      currentClassContext = context;
274      var testClass = context.getRequiredTestClass();
275      var scoped = buildClassScopeStoreWithMode(testClass);
276      context.getStore(NAMESPACE).put(KEY_CLASS_STORE, scoped.store());
277      // Mode OVERLAY push (if attached) — only fires when at least one class-scope @TestBean declared
278      // mode = Mode.OVERLAY.  All declarations in the scope must agree on the mode (mixing throws in
279      // buildClassScopeStoreWithMode).
280      var snapshot = pushOverlayIfOverlayMode(scoped);
281      if (snapshot != null)
282         context.getStore(NAMESPACE).put(KEY_CLASS_SNAPSHOT, snapshot);
283   }
284
285   @Override /* AfterAllCallback */
286   public void afterAll(ExtensionContext context) {
287      popOverlayIfPresent(context, KEY_CLASS_SNAPSHOT);
288      context.getStore(NAMESPACE).remove(KEY_CLASS_STORE);
289      currentClassContext = null;
290   }
291
292   @Override /* BeforeEachCallback */
293   public void beforeEach(ExtensionContext context) {
294      currentMethodContext = context;
295      var classStore = readClassStore(context);
296      var testInstance = context.getRequiredTestInstance();
297      var scoped = buildMethodScopeStoreWithMode(testInstance, classStore);
298      context.getStore(NAMESPACE).put(KEY_METHOD_STORE, scoped.store());
299      var snapshot = pushOverlayIfOverlayMode(scoped);
300      if (snapshot != null)
301         context.getStore(NAMESPACE).put(KEY_METHOD_SNAPSHOT, snapshot);
302   }
303
304   @Override /* AfterEachCallback */
305   public void afterEach(ExtensionContext context) {
306      popOverlayIfPresent(context, KEY_METHOD_SNAPSHOT);
307      context.getStore(NAMESPACE).remove(KEY_METHOD_STORE);
308      currentMethodContext = null;
309   }
310
311   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
312   // Mode OVERLAY push/pop helpers
313   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
314
315   private PushedOverlay pushOverlayIfOverlayMode(ScopedStore scoped) {
316      if (scoped.mode() != Mode.OVERLAY || scoped.empty())
317         return null;
318      var store = attached.get();
319      if (store == null)
320         throw new IllegalStateException(
321            "@TestBean(mode = Mode.OVERLAY) declared but JuneauBeanStoreExtension was not attached to a"
322            + " WritableBeanStore.  Call extension.attach(sut.getBeanStore()) from @BeforeAll / @BeforeEach"
323            + " before the test runs.");
324      var snapshot = store.pushOverlay(scoped.store());
325      return new PushedOverlay(store, snapshot);
326   }
327
328   private static void popOverlayIfPresent(ExtensionContext context, String key) {
329      var pushed = (PushedOverlay) context.getStore(NAMESPACE).remove(key);
330      if (pushed == null)
331         return;
332      // Pop against the original store reference captured at push time, so the pop works even if the test
333      // has since detach()-ed the extension or attach()-ed it to a different store.
334      pushed.store().popOverlay(pushed.snapshot());
335   }
336
337   /** Captures the {@link WritableBeanStore} an overlay was pushed against, plus the resulting {@link Snapshot}. */
338   private record PushedOverlay(WritableBeanStore store, Snapshot snapshot) { /* no body */ }
339
340   @Override /* ParameterResolver */
341   public boolean supportsParameter(ParameterContext parameterContext, ExtensionContext extensionContext) {
342      return parameterContext.getParameter().getType() == TestBeanStore.class;
343   }
344
345   @Override /* ParameterResolver */
346   public Object resolveParameter(ParameterContext parameterContext, ExtensionContext extensionContext) {
347      // Prefer the method-scope store from the supplied extensionContext (the parameter being resolved belongs to
348      // the test method currently executing); fall back to class-scope when the parameter is resolved outside a
349      // method context (rare — e.g. constructor injection on a TestInstance.Lifecycle.PER_METHOD test class).
350      var methodStore = (TestBeanStore) extensionContext.getStore(NAMESPACE).get(KEY_METHOD_STORE);
351      if (methodStore != null)
352         return methodStore;
353      var classStore = readClassStore(extensionContext);
354      if (classStore != null)
355         return classStore;
356      throw new ParameterResolutionException(
357         "JuneauBeanStoreExtension cannot resolve TestBeanStore parameter: no overlay is active.");
358   }
359
360   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
361   // Discovery
362   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
363
364   /**
365    * Builds a class-scope overlay for the supplied test class.
366    *
367    * <p>
368    * Walks the class hierarchy parent-to-child registering every {@code @TestBean(scope = CLASS)} declared on a
369    * {@code static} field or {@code static} method.  Non-static {@code scope = CLASS} declarations throw an
370    * {@link ExtensionContextException} &mdash; instance state isn't available at {@code beforeAll} time.
371    *
372    * <p>
373    * Package-private to allow direct unit testing of the discovery logic without driving the full JUnit lifecycle.
374    */
375   static TestBeanStore buildClassScopeStore(Class<?> testClass) {
376      return buildClassScopeStoreWithMode(testClass).store();
377   }
378
379   /**
380    * Builds a method-scope overlay for the supplied test instance, optionally chained on top of a class-scope
381    * overlay.
382    *
383    * <p>
384    * Package-private to allow direct unit testing of the discovery logic without driving the full JUnit lifecycle.
385    */
386   static TestBeanStore buildMethodScopeStore(Object testInstance, TestBeanStore classScopeParent) {
387      return buildMethodScopeStoreWithMode(testInstance, classScopeParent).store();
388   }
389
390   /**
391    * {@link #buildClassScopeStore(Class)} plus the unified mode (INJECT or OVERLAY) of all class-scope
392    * declarations.
393    *
394    * <p>
395    * Mixing {@code Mode.INJECT} and {@code Mode.OVERLAY} declarations in the same scope throws an
396    * {@link IllegalStateException}.
397    */
398   static ScopedStore buildClassScopeStoreWithMode(Class<?> testClass) {
399      var store = new TestBeanStore();
400      var modeTracker = new ModeTracker(Scope.CLASS);
401      populateStaticOverrides(store, testClass, modeTracker);
402      return new ScopedStore(store, modeTracker.resolve(), modeTracker.empty());
403   }
404
405   /**
406    * {@link #buildMethodScopeStore(Object, TestBeanStore)} plus the unified mode (INJECT or OVERLAY) of all
407    * method-scope declarations.
408    *
409    * <p>
410    * Mixing {@code Mode.INJECT} and {@code Mode.OVERLAY} declarations in the same scope throws an
411    * {@link IllegalStateException}.
412    */
413   static ScopedStore buildMethodScopeStoreWithMode(Object testInstance, TestBeanStore classScopeParent) {
414      var store = new TestBeanStore(classScopeParent);
415      var modeTracker = new ModeTracker(Scope.METHOD);
416      populateInstanceOverrides(store, testInstance, modeTracker);
417      return new ScopedStore(store, modeTracker.resolve(), modeTracker.empty());
418   }
419
420   /**
421    * Discovers the {@code @TestBean} overrides declared on a test instance (and its class hierarchy) and returns
422    * them as a single {@link OverrideSet} &mdash; the public composition entry point for other JUnit 5 extensions
423    * (e.g. {@code @MicroserviceTest}) that need the {@code @TestBean} substrate without driving this extension's
424    * own lifecycle.
425    *
426    * <p>
427    * Both {@code @TestBean(scope = CLASS)} (static) and {@code @TestBean(scope = METHOD)} (instance) declarations
428    * are collected into one flattened overlay (method-scope chained over class-scope), so a composing extension
429    * that boots a single system-under-test per scope sees every declared override. The returned
430    * {@link OverrideSet#mode()} is the unified mode of all declarations (defaulting to {@link Mode#INJECT} when
431    * none are present); mixing {@code INJECT} and {@code OVERLAY} in one scope throws {@link IllegalStateException}.
432    *
433    * @param testInstance The test-class instance to scan. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
434    * @return The discovered overrides + their unified mode. Never <jk>null</jk>; {@link OverrideSet#isEmpty()} is
435    *    <jk>true</jk> when no {@code @TestBean} members were found.
436    * @since 10.0.0
437    */
438   public static OverrideSet discoverOverrides(Object testInstance) {
439      reqnn("testInstance", testInstance);
440      var classScoped = buildClassScopeStoreWithMode(testInstance.getClass());
441      var methodScoped = buildMethodScopeStoreWithMode(testInstance, classScoped.store());
442      // Unify the two scopes' modes: an empty scope contributes no constraint; a populated one does.
443      var mode = methodScoped.empty() ? classScoped.mode() : methodScoped.mode();
444      if (! classScoped.empty() && ! methodScoped.empty() && classScoped.mode() != methodScoped.mode())
445         throw new IllegalStateException(
446            "Mixed @TestBean modes across scopes: CLASS declares Mode." + classScoped.mode()
447            + " but METHOD declares Mode." + methodScoped.mode()
448            + ".  All @TestBean declarations must use the same mode for a single-boot SUT.");
449      var empty = classScoped.empty() && methodScoped.empty();
450      return new OverrideSet(methodScoped.store(), mode, empty);
451   }
452
453   /**
454    * The flattened result of {@link #discoverOverrides(Object)}: the {@code @TestBean} overlay store, the unified
455    * {@link Mode} of all declarations, and whether any were found.
456    *
457    * @param store The overlay {@link BeanStore} carrying the discovered overrides (method-scope chained over
458    *    class-scope). Usable directly as a builder {@code overridingBeanStore(...)} argument for {@link Mode#INJECT},
459    *    or as a {@code pushOverlay(...)} argument for {@link Mode#OVERLAY}.
460    * @param mode The unified declaration mode ({@link Mode#INJECT} by default).
461    * @param empty Whether no {@code @TestBean} members were discovered.
462    * @since 10.0.0
463    */
464   public record OverrideSet(TestBeanStore store, Mode mode, boolean empty) {
465
466      /**
467       * Returns whether no {@code @TestBean} members were discovered.
468       *
469       * @return <jk>true</jk> if the override set is empty.
470       */
471      public boolean isEmpty() {
472         return empty;
473      }
474   }
475
476   /**
477    * Walks the test-class hierarchy and registers every {@code @TestBean(scope = CLASS)} declared on a
478    * {@code static} field or {@code static} method.
479    *
480    * <p>
481    * Non-static {@code scope = CLASS} declarations are rejected with an {@link ExtensionContextException} &mdash;
482    * instance state isn't available at {@code beforeAll} time.
483    */
484   private static void populateStaticOverrides(TestBeanStore store, Class<?> testClass, ModeTracker modeTracker) {
485      for (var c : classHierarchy(testClass)) {
486         for (var f : c.getDeclaredFields()) {
487            var ann = f.getAnnotation(TestBean.class);
488            if (ann == null || ann.scope() != Scope.CLASS)
489               continue;
490            if (!Modifier.isStatic(f.getModifiers()))
491               throw new ExtensionContextException(
492                  "@TestBean(scope = CLASS) field must be static: " + describe(f));
493            modeTracker.observe(ann.mode(), describe(f));
494            register(store, f, null, ann);
495         }
496         for (var m : c.getDeclaredMethods()) {
497            var ann = m.getAnnotation(TestBean.class);
498            if (ann == null || ann.scope() != Scope.CLASS)
499               continue;
500            if (!Modifier.isStatic(m.getModifiers()))
501               throw new ExtensionContextException(
502                  "@TestBean(scope = CLASS) method must be static: " + describe(m));
503            modeTracker.observe(ann.mode(), describe(m));
504            register(store, m, null, ann);
505         }
506      }
507   }
508
509   /**
510    * Walks the test-instance class hierarchy and registers every {@code @TestBean(scope = METHOD)} declared on a
511    * field or method.
512    *
513    * <p>
514    * Honors both instance and static members ("behave consistently with
515    * non-static" for {@code scope = METHOD} on static fields).
516    */
517   private static void populateInstanceOverrides(TestBeanStore store, Object testInstance, ModeTracker modeTracker) {
518      var testClass = testInstance.getClass();
519      for (var c : classHierarchy(testClass)) {
520         for (var f : c.getDeclaredFields()) {
521            var ann = f.getAnnotation(TestBean.class);
522            if (ann == null || ann.scope() != Scope.METHOD)
523               continue;
524            modeTracker.observe(ann.mode(), describe(f));
525            register(store, f, Modifier.isStatic(f.getModifiers()) ? null : testInstance, ann);
526         }
527         for (var m : c.getDeclaredMethods()) {
528            var ann = m.getAnnotation(TestBean.class);
529            if (ann == null || ann.scope() != Scope.METHOD)
530               continue;
531            modeTracker.observe(ann.mode(), describe(m));
532            register(store, m, Modifier.isStatic(m.getModifiers()) ? null : testInstance, ann);
533         }
534      }
535   }
536
537   /** Carries the discovered overlay plus the resolved {@link Mode} for a single scope. */
538   record ScopedStore(TestBeanStore store, Mode mode, boolean empty) { /* no body */ }
539
540   /**
541    * Tracks the {@link Mode} of {@code @TestBean} declarations encountered within a single scope and rejects
542    * mixed-mode declarations.
543    */
544   private static final class ModeTracker {
545      private final Scope scope;
546      private Mode observed;
547      private String firstMember;
548      private boolean empty = true;
549
550      ModeTracker(Scope scope) {
551         this.scope = scope;
552      }
553
554      void observe(Mode mode, String memberDesc) {
555         empty = false;
556         if (observed == null) {
557            observed = mode;
558            firstMember = memberDesc;
559            return;
560         }
561         if (observed != mode)
562            throw new IllegalStateException(
563               "Mixed @TestBean modes in " + scope + " scope: " + firstMember + " declares Mode." + observed
564               + " but " + memberDesc + " declares Mode." + mode
565               + ".  All @TestBean declarations in a single scope must use the same mode.");
566      }
567
568      Mode resolve() {
569         return observed == null ? Mode.INJECT : observed;
570      }
571
572      boolean empty() {
573         return empty;
574      }
575   }
576
577   private static void register(TestBeanStore store, Field field, Object instance, TestBean ann) {
578      Object value;
579      try {
580         field.setAccessible(true);
581         value = field.get(instance);
582      } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
583         throw new ExtensionContextException("Could not read @TestBean field: " + describe(field), e);
584      }
585      var type = ann.type() == Object.class ? field.getType() : ann.type();
586      registerValue(store, type, value, ann.name(), describe(field));
587   }
588
589   private static void register(TestBeanStore store, Method method, Object instance, TestBean ann) {
590      if (method.getParameterCount() != 0)
591         throw new ExtensionContextException(
592            "@TestBean factory method must be parameterless: " + describe(method));
593      Object value;
594      try {
595         method.setAccessible(true);
596         value = method.invoke(instance);
597      } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
598         throw new ExtensionContextException(
599            "Failed to invoke @TestBean factory method: " + describe(method),
600            or(e.getCause(), e));
601      }
602      var type = ann.type() == Object.class ? method.getReturnType() : ann.type();
603      registerValue(store, type, value, ann.name(), describe(method));
604   }
605
606   @SuppressWarnings({
607      "unchecked" // The type token came from either the annotated member's declared type or ann.type(); the value's runtime class is compatible by construction.
608   })
609   private static void registerValue(TestBeanStore store, Class<?> type, Object value, String name, String memberDesc) {
610      if (value != null && !type.isInstance(value))
611         throw new ExtensionContextException(
612            "@TestBean value is not assignable to declared type " + type.getName() + ": " + memberDesc);
613      store.override((Class<Object>) type, value, name.isEmpty() ? null : name);
614   }
615
616   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
617   // Internal helpers
618   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
619
620   private TestBeanStore currentMethodStore() {
621      return currentMethodContext == null ? null : (TestBeanStore) currentMethodContext.getStore(NAMESPACE).get(KEY_METHOD_STORE);
622   }
623
624   private TestBeanStore currentClassStore() {
625      return currentClassContext == null ? null : readClassStore(currentClassContext);
626   }
627
628   /**
629    * Reads the class-scope store from the nearest enclosing context that owns one.
630    *
631    * <p>
632    * JUnit's {@code ExtensionContext.Store} keys are scoped per context.  When a method-scope callback fires, the
633    * incoming context is the method-level context whose own store does <i>not</i> contain the class-scope entry;
634    * the class-scope entry lives on the parent (class-level) context.  This helper walks parents until it finds
635    * one whose store contains the class-scope entry, or returns {@code null} if none does.
636    */
637   private static TestBeanStore readClassStore(ExtensionContext context) {
638      for (var c = context; c != null; c = c.getParent().orElse(null)) {
639         var s = (TestBeanStore) c.getStore(NAMESPACE).get(KEY_CLASS_STORE);
640         if (s != null)
641            return s;
642      }
643      return null;
644   }
645
646   private static List<Class<?>> classHierarchy(Class<?> testClass) {
647      // Walk parent-to-child so a subclass's @TestBean of the same (type, name) wins over the parent's via the
648      // "last write wins" semantics of BasicBeanStore.addBean(...).
649      var hierarchy = new ArrayList<Class<?>>();
650      for (var c = testClass; c != null && c != Object.class; c = c.getSuperclass())
651         hierarchy.add(c);
652      Collections.reverse(hierarchy);
653      return hierarchy;
654   }
655
656   private static String describe(Field f) {
657      return f.getDeclaringClass().getName() + "#" + f.getName();
658   }
659
660   private static String describe(Method m) {
661      return m.getDeclaringClass().getName() + "#" + m.getName() + "()";
662   }
663}
